note: 流し is a natural sink term, but its ordinary sense is chiefly a kitchen sink; the stated basin sense also covers other washing sinks, and no wider verified single equivalent is clear.
叫び声 (JMdict ent_seq 1235900, sense 0) glosses scream and is less tied to fear or pain than 悲鳴, so it better covers excited or angry screams.
日誌 naturally means a daily log, while nhật ký most readily suggests a personal diary; the English definition spans personal and organizational or vessel records.
chương trình is broader than an entertainment show; chương trình giải trí preserves the broadcast-program sense and its light-entertainment emphasis.
湿っぽい usually means damp or clammy and does not cover the full liquid-covered sense of wet; ướt is apt, but no verified general Japanese adjective fix is available here.
きれい (JMdict ent_seq 1591900, sense 1) is glossed clean and is the everyday word for a physically clean object; 清い mainly suggests purity.
終える (JMdict ent_seq 1332760, sense 0) means to bring something to an end; kết thúc is a natural Vietnamese verb for both finishing and terminating.
刈り取る (JMdict ent_seq 1209430, sense 0) is glossed to reap and harvest, matching the grain-cutting sense more closely than the broader 刈る.
留める (JMdict ent_seq 1310670, sense 5) is glossed to fasten, tack, pin, nail, or button and better covers securely attaching an item than 締める.
thể dục is general exercise or physical education; thể dục dụng cụ is the standard Vietnamese name for the sport of gymnastics.
調味料 and gia vị are the ordinary broad terms for seasonings and condiments; the eater-added detail describes usage, not a separate lexical category.
編む and đan are standard verbs for making fabric by knitting yarn into loops; their additional braid or plait senses do not obscure this core use.
桁 (JMdict ent_seq 1253800, sense 1) is glossed digit, decade, and order of magnitude, fitting a numeral's place in a positional system better than 数字.
độ ẩm usually denotes humidity or its measured level; hơi ẩm names moisture more generally and aligns better with the state of being moist.
檻 and lồng both naturally denote barred enclosures for animals; the definition's animal-holding sense fits these everyday equivalents.
一度 (JMdict ent_seq 1576250, sense 0) is glossed once, one time, and on one occasion; いったん instead suggests for the time being or once a condition is reached.
五 (JMdict ent_seq 1268060, sense 0) is glossed five; 五つ is the native counter form for five generic objects rather than the bare numeral.
ごらん is understandable as look, but is a familiar directive often used downward to a child or subordinate; that register is not reliably conveyed by the neutral English prompt.
アクション is the conventional director's call to begin a take; its dictionary noun part of speech does not prevent this established interjection use.
最高気温 (JMdict ent_seq 2848153, sense 0) is glossed maximum temperature and today's high, matching the daily maximum sense rather than 高温.
位置付ける means placing something within a larger system or ranking it; this is narrower than putting an object into place, and no verified direct replacement is established.
罰 (JMdict ent_seq 1478060, sense 0) is glossed punishment and penalty, while 処罰 usually emphasizes formal or official punishment.
盛ん is a natural adjective for thriving or flourishing activity and enterprise, matching the stated flourishing and prosperous senses.
こんにちは is the standard Japanese daytime hello and chào is a natural Vietnamese greeting; both convey the stated greeting despite the Japanese time-of-day convention.
団結 is unity or solidarity among people acting together, narrower than the abstract oneness of a single undivided entity in this definition.
アナウンサー and phát thanh viên usually denote professional broadcast presenters; the English definition also includes any person who makes announcements.
ドリル and máy khoan name the drilling machine, not the component that drives its bit; the supplied equivalences therefore denote the wrong part.
肌 (JMdict ent_seq 1476450, sense 0) is glossed skin and is the ordinary everyday Japanese word; 皮膚 is accurate but more technical or medical.
気体 (JMdict ent_seq 1222460, sense 0) is glossed gas and gaseous body, the precise scientific term for the state of matter rather than fuel gas.
集中 denotes concentration of attention, but trọng tâm is a focal point; sự tập trung is the natural Vietnamese noun for the stated concentration sense.
出席 (JMdict ent_seq 1339460, sense 0) is glossed attendance and presence; 来場 is limited to attending a venue or event.
最近 is the standard Japanese adverb for recently, and mới đây is a natural Vietnamese equivalent for the recent past.
十年 directly means ten years and expresses a decade-length period; thập niên is the standard Vietnamese term for a decade.
前後関係 usually means textual context or surrounding relations, narrower than circumstances and background that clarify any event or occurrence.
画像 (JMdict ent_seq 1197390, sense 0) is glossed image and picture; hình ảnh denotes a graphical image more broadly than ảnh, which often means a photograph.
売店 and quầy fit a sales stall or kiosk, but the English definition also includes a stand or stage such as a bandstand.
意外 (JMdict ent_seq 1156410, sense 0) is glossed unexpected and surprising without the negative or unfortunate implication typical of とんだ.
閲覧 is a natural match for the reading or perusal sense explicitly included in the English definition; it need not cover physical inspections of objects.
検査 (JMdict ent_seq 1257890, sense 0) is glossed inspection, examination, and check, a more general equivalent than official-tour 視察.
素材 covers ingredients as well as raw materials and resources, all senses listed in the English gloss; this is a natural Japanese noun for the stated concept.
